recall.minute: Ladder: unigram baseline (~90%; She books → NNS, 4/5 right) → HMM/MEMM/CRF (~95–96%) → Bi-LSTM-CRF (~97–98%) → fine-tuned Transformer (~98.5–99.5%) → LLM prompting → agents with a tagger tool. Embeddings: cos(king, queen) = 0.996, cos(king, cat) = −0.135; character embeddings use suffixes for OOV words; input = [word ; char]. LSTM: f = σ(0.72) = 0.673, i = 0.666, g = 0.641, c = 0.763, o = 0.657, h = 0.422; Bi-LSTM concatenates both directions. CRF: Score = Σ E + Σ T, P = e^Score/Z; 'the plays': DT NN 11 vs greedy DT VBZ 7; Z ≈ 61,402.9; P(DT NN) = 0.975. 0.97²⁰ ≈ 0.544, 0.99²⁰ ≈ 0.818; 30,000 vs 10,000 errors per million. Attention for 'bank': scores 5, 2, 2 /√2 → weights 0.807, 0.097, 0.097 → [0.145, 0.855]. BERT head: logits −1.15, 0.79, 2.15 → VBZ 0.773; tag first subword. Prompt: zero-shot may output ADJ; few-shot examples give JJ. Agent: plan → POS_tag tool → battery +0.8, screen −0.6.

flashcards: Read → plan → call tool → read output → finish
